# Coremagna

> AI automation agency for law firms and professional services. We help service businesses automate client intake, phone calls, appointment booking, and lead management using AI chatbots, voice agents, and workflow automation.

## What We Do

We help professional services firms automate client intake, phone calls, appointment booking, and lead management using AI chatbots, voice agents, and workflow automation. Founded by Ferit Patefe, based in Antalya, Turkey, serving clients internationally.

## Industries

- Law Firms: After-hours intake, AI receptionist, case enquiry routing, CRM lead automation, document automation, system integration
- Restaurants: Reservation automation, no-show reminders, review management, phone/call handling, guest retention
- Dental & Medical Clinics: Appointment scheduling, recall reminders, patient intake, missed-call recovery, online reputation
- Real Estate: Lead capture, fast lead response, viewing scheduling, vendor communication, lead nurture
- Beauty Salons: Booking automation, no-show reminders, client follow-up and rebooking, social/reputation visibility

## Products

- AI Visibility audit and fix sprint: for law firms, dental practices and other local professional firms. Coremagna asks ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity the questions the firm's clients ask, repeats every question several times because AI answers change between runs, and counts how often the firm is named and who is named instead. A 14-day fix sprint then changes what those answers are built from: the firm's own website, its Google Business Profile, reviews, directory listings, AI crawler access and structured data. A second measurement follows 30 days later. Coremagna does not promise that an assistant will name a firm; it promises the work and a dated before and after count. Free check: 5 questions on 3 assistants, one page. Fix sprint: $997 one time (10 questions, 150 answers, 14 days of fixes, second measurement). Monthly tracking: $297 a month. See https://coremagna.com/ai-visibility
- Ad Creative Testing: for e-commerce brands that advertise on Facebook and Instagram. Each month Coremagna researches four new ad concepts, produces 12 short video ads from the brand's product photos and footage (four concepts with three hooks each) plus four variations of the previous winner, sets up a like-for-like test in the brand's Meta ad account, and sends a one-page readout of hook rate, click rate and cost per purchase with a verdict for each concept. No return on ad spend is promised, no AI presenter poses as a customer, and ad spend is paid by the brand directly to Meta. Pilot: $997 one time for 10 ads. Monthly testing: $1,997 a month. See https://coremagna.com/ad-creative-testing
- Expert Content: for law firms, dental practices and other professional firms. One recorded 60-minute interview with a partner each month becomes four answer pages with the partner's byline, eight short videos of the partner, eight posts for LinkedIn and Google Business Profile, and four quote cards. A real person is on camera, never an avatar or a cloned voice, and nothing is published without the partner's and the firm's sign-off. AI is used for the transcript and a first draft; a person edits every page against the recording. Single session: $997 one time. Monthly: $1,497 a month. See https://coremagna.com/expert-content
- AI Property Video Tours: done-for-you property video tours built from an estate agent's existing listing photographs. Camera movement is generated from the stills, so no camera, crew or site visit is involved. Optional AI presenter walks the property on screen. Delivered in 48 hours in portal, Instagram Reels and TikTok aspect ratios from one render, with unlimited free revisions until the agent signs off. Two packages: Classic Walkthrough, and AI Presenter Video which adds a presenter who introduces and walks the property on camera. Priced as a flat fee per listing, quoted on the call. Positioned between self-serve AI video tools ($4-16 a video, the agent does the work) and a videographer (£250-500 per shoot plus scheduling and property access): studio output with none of the work on the agent's side. Used for residential sales, lettings, commercial units and short-term rentals. Coremagna does not alter what a property actually looks like - no added furniture, no removed defects, no changed views - and supplies disclosure wording with every delivery. See https://coremagna.com/real-estate-videos
- AI Product Videos: product ads, UGC-style presenter videos, motion pieces and product shots for e-commerce brands, generated with AI from the brand's own product photos, then scripted and edited by Coremagna. Delivered in vertical, square and wide formats for TikTok, Reels, Meta and YouTube ads, product pages and marketplace listings. AI presenters never claim results as a customer in client work. Every project is quoted in writing before work starts. Portfolio: https://coremagna.com/product-videos
- AI Chatbot (RAG): 24/7 client intake and FAQ automation, answers only from your own business data
- AI Voice Agent: Intelligent inbound call handling, qualification, and appointment booking
- Workflow Automation: n8n-based process automation across your existing tools
- CRM & Lead Forms: Automated lead capture and follow-up
- Ad Automation: AI-optimized Google and Meta advertising campaigns
- Web Design: Conversion-optimized professional websites delivered in 3-7 days

## Related

- Miravely (https://miravely.com): a separate self-serve product built by Coremagna's founder, Ferit Patefe. Estate agents use it to stage and restyle listing photos and to turn a set of listing photos into a video tour themselves, with walls, windows and doors held where the photos put them. Coremagna is the done-for-you option; Miravely is the do-it-yourself one.

- The plans below are for the automation services (chatbot, voice agent, workflows):

- API costs billed at cost with no markup
